messages:
Sam: Heads-up — merged PR #4821 a few mins ago and main CI flipped red immediately :rotating_light: 
CI Bot: pipeline/main smoke-gpu #3478 failed (step: gpu-smoke-run). Summary: 1 failing test, 2 warnings. logs: https://ci.internal/runs/3478 
Maya: who can grab this? can we try a quick rerun first? :eyes: 
Liam: I can look. rerun queued? if it reproduces we should bisect. pinging @Sam for which commit exactly got merged 
Sam: that was merge commit a1f4c9d (PR 4821) — small change to kvcache eviction heuristic, but should be safe. 
Liam: thanks. grabbing logs now — failing test appears to be tests/gpu/test_integration_kvcache.py::test_kv_eviction_when_full 
Liam: log snippet: ```
E   AssertionError: Expected cache miss count <= 3 but got 7
...
RuntimeError: GPU OOM while allocating 1.2 GiB
``` 
Alex: I glanced at PR — it nudges eviction threshold at the allocator layer; possible interaction with kv allocation sizing. 
CI Bot: rerun request accepted for pipeline/main smoke-gpu #3479 (triggered by Liam) 
Maya: if rerun passes we can mark as transient and close. if it fails, bisect. 
Liam: rerun in progress... 
CI Bot: pipeline/main smoke-gpu #3479 completed — FAIL (same test) 
Liam: same failure on rerun. I'll start a bisect across the last 5 commits including the merge. starting with binary search set. 
Sam: thanks — if bisect points at the PR I can open an emergency revert. 
Liam: quick note: I'm going to disable cross-shard batching in the bisect runs to reduce noise (will add that flag in the bisect script). 
Alex: FYI I can hold off the deploy window if you want to revert quickly. 
Liam: bisect progress: tested a1f4c9d -> fail, tested parent 9c3b2e1 -> pass. Narrowing to commits between 9c3b2e1 and a1f4c9d. 
Maya: :+1: keep us posted. tagging infra-oncall for visibility. 
Liam: bisect result: culprit appears to be a1f4c9d (the merge). Repro command: `pytest tests/gpu/test_integration_kvcache.py::test_kv_eviction_when_full -k eviction -q` on GPU node with small cache limit. 
Sam: I'll open a revert PR now and attach the bisect logs. apologies for the churn. 
Maya: thanks Sam & Liam. once revert is in we should rerun the smoke matrix and confirm. 
CI Bot: alert created: incident/ci-main-smoke-1768001234 (severity: low) — updates will be posted here.
